descriptiveMetadata.title: OpenUBEM Buildings - ES-MAD-BERRUGUETE
descriptiveMetadata.abstract: OpenUBEM district export for ES-MAD-BERRUGUETE (1194 buildings). Source artifacts: 02_residential_manifest.gpkg, EU11_results_2026-10-08_per_home.csv. Primary choropleth attribute: eui_heating_kwh_m2.

chapters.title: 1. District Morphology & Provenance

chapters.title: 2. Choropleth Distribution (eui_heating_kwh_m2)
